How it works

One clear update instead of a surprise outage.

Technical checks happen in the background. Your team gets the context needed to make a decision.

1

Trace checks your API

It compares the latest API description with the version your team already uses.

2

It explains the impact

Trace identifies the important change and the product areas most likely to need attention.

3

A short report tells you what to update, who should look at it, and why it matters.
